name: Handle Ewer
description: The teapot, also known as Zhuzi or Zhuke, originally had its shape derived from bronze vessels. It was mostly used as a wine container and tea set. It is loved by the people due to its shape, function and aesthetics and has been passed down to this day. Holding the pot, I have traveled through thousands of years and endless lives. Holding this pot, I drink all the elegance.
